entry_points.text: Sub bring-up tail orders arena, shard storage, linkage, sysfs, depth check, kernel objects, init op, attach, bypass, op bitmap, cgroup claim, two-phase adoption, bypass release, cap seeding, log and uevent with central failure teardown.

Cgroup task migration splits prepare, complete under rq lock and cancel, each no-op when disabled or already homed; lifetime inherits scheduler on online and shuts down on group offline; init registers notifiers.

Fair current refresh walks enclosing queues; cache tick inert when disabled or epoch unchanged else queues work; deferred NUMA work enforces scan frequency, sets budgets and pid-aware VMA iteration with forced rescan.

exports.text: Parent drives direct child by cgroup id: locked dispatch when base cap held reports work; grant/revoke caps over cid mask per shard with batched notify; query unions; kill exits.
Fair class linkage with bandwidth and promote tunables; NUMA scan min 1000 max 60000 size 256 delay 1000 hot from HZ; distance presence check; group detach and fault teardown.
Reentry detectors flag dispatch and caps-update recursion; non-cid grant, query and kill report unsupported while revoke no-ops; cgroup path resolves to scheduler path or root.

hazards.text: Iteration may revisit exiting tasks so markers skip duplicates and refs pin across release; death between init and rq lock cancels init; failures keep bypass engaged, record error, flush disable and suppress double handling.

Weighted accumulation overflow widens shift and rebuilds by timeline walk, fatal at shift ten; promotion windows use atomic exchange so losers skip; rq current observation tolerates exiting threads and self selection; scan races treated as sampling noise.
Mismatched fault identity aborts join; alloc failures skip grouping; footprint updates clamp against wrap; every acquired group ref pairs a drop to avoid leaks or early free.

invariants.text: Child enable checks depth, runs init then parent attach, marks initialized, builds op bitmap from present ops, claims cgroups before tasks, requires ready or enabled tasks, seeds owed caps after enable.

Capability preamble resolves caller and direct child and validates mask; grant intersects with parent holdings per cid and queues sync for changed cids; revoke walks descendants and skips clean subtrees; query tolerates unpublished storage; invalid masks, unknown or non-direct targets and out-of-set bits fail safely.

Fair timeline orders by entity precedence with cached min vruntime, min slice and max slice; enqueue folds weighted accumulators; eligibility derives from zero point plus averaged offset; protection deadlines only move earlier.

Cache group publishes per-CPU runtime and epoch with release order, refcounted with RCU free across fork, exec and exit; tick queues single-shot work on epoch advance; worker rate-limits, elects scanner and picks busiest LLC with hysteresis.

Node stats accumulate load and capacity and classify spare, busy or overloaded; compare blends fault differentials with preferred bonuses and load checks; search tries idle then swaps; top level scans preferred node first.

Fault windows decay by half and fold new observations with runtime normalization; scan period lengthens on idle or local and shortens on private remote; groups form by majority with topology-aware preferred node and period-fraction retry.

locks.text: Enable holds enable mutex plus fork-write and cgroup lock over claim and sweeps with iterator release around init and rq lock for moves; cross-group transfer uses address-ordered double lock.
Grant and revoke save irqs and nest parent then child locks in order with notify after unlock; dispatch and lookup use RCU.

Cache group lock serializes epoch and work queue with RCU for publication; NUMA domain and rq current observed under RCU; per-rq migration flag claimed by atomic exchange with fallback to another idle CPU.

state_machines.text: Adoption uses per-task marker over two sweeps: first initializes for child while on parent, second moves marked tasks with disable, exit, assign and enable and clears marker; abort only cancels init and keeps enabling pointer until markers clear.
Node cycles spare, busy, overloaded by running versus weight and capacity pressure; balancing cycles fault observation, sequence-guarded placement and preferred migration.

structs.text: Cid mask has base, logical and allocated counts with flexible words and stack shard helper; shard has base and count; topo pairs id and index for core, cache, node and shard; ref binds scheduler, mask and intervals.

NUMA group holds refcount, lock, counts, id, actives, RCU and fault arrays; stats summarize demand versus capacity plus cached idle CPU; search env tracks endpoints, summaries, tolerance and best candidate.

Scheduler limits: nesting 4; dispatch batch and loops 32; iter batch 32; id chunk 1024; requeue 256; watchdog 30 ticks; rescue bandwidth and quanta bounds; exit, message and dump lens; bypass interval and shard sizes.

Tunable log mode; base and normalized 700000; bandwidth 5000; promote 65536; mult all-set shift 32; epoch 10ms timeout 50ms; LLC tol 1 imb 20 over 50; buckets 8; window 2560; slots 10 thresh 7; pid reset 4x delay; fraction 3; smallimp 30; steps 16.
